papers.title: Prospective multicenter non-randomized controlled study on intraosseous stability and healing period for dental implants in the posterior region.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: A current implant body surface was treated with "rough processing" by sandblasting and acid etching for the purposes of obtaining more reliable osseointegration and shortening the treatment period. Various reports have examined the healing period with the use of these implant bodies, but a consensus opinion has not yet been obtained. The purpose of this study is to evaluate the relationship between insertion torque (IT) and implant stability quotient (ISQ) at implant treatment using the current rough-surfaced implant. We evaluated the implant treatment sites with ISQ values, IT values, and voxel values. METHODS: Participants in this study comprised 26 patients (10 males, 16 females; mean age, 55.5 years) who received posterior region dental implants at Tokyo Dental College Hospital or Fukuoka Dental College Hospital. For all participants, pretreatment computed tomography and determination of bone quality from voxel values were performed. Thirty-two implant bodies were inserted into the posterior region, and insertion torque was measured. ISQ was also measured at 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 12 weeks postoperatively. RESULTS: Eight implant bodies in the maxilla and 24 in the mandible were inserted. All ISQ values increased, exceeding 60 by 6 weeks postoperatively. For insertion torque < 30 N cm, ISQ increased significantly after 8 weeks. For ≥ 30 N cm, the ratio at which high ISQ values appeared increased significantly after 6 weeks. Compared with the treatment area with insertion torque < 40 N cm, the treatment area ≥ 40 N cm showed a significantly higher voxel value. CONCLUSIONS: No significant relationship was found between the insertion torque value and the ISQ value. Also, it was suggested that the ISQ value was considered to be an important indicator for observing the treatment state of the implant.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是牙科植入物临床研究，未涉及增材制造、多孔结构或力学测试，与用户研究方向的AM生物医学材料无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical study on dental implant stability, with no additive manufacturing, porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, or mechanical testing of fabricated implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估粗糙表面牙种植体在不同插入扭矩下的稳定性与愈合周期。
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性多中心非随机对照试验，测量26名患者后牙区种植体的插入扭矩、ISQ值和骨密度。
summary_zh.result: 术后6周ISQ均超过60，插入扭矩≥30 N·cm组ISQ高值出现率在6周后显著增加。
summary_zh.validation: 通过临床多中心数据验证，比较不同扭矩组ISQ变化。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the relationship between insertion torque and implant stability quotient (ISQ) during healing of rough-surfaced dental implants.
summary_en.method: A prospective multicenter non-randomized controlled study was conducted on 26 patients receiving posterior dental implants, measuring IT, ISQ over 12 weeks, and preoperative bone voxel values.
summary_en.result: All implants achieved ISQ >60 by 6 weeks; higher IT (≥30 N·cm) led to earlier significant increases in high ISQ values at 6 weeks.
summary_en.validation: Clinical validation through patient data from two hospitals with longitudinal ISQ measurements and subgroup analysis by IT.
